Case note: CS(COMM) 2719/2020
Client: Joseph Joshi (truck driver, Kozhikode)
Opposing party: Shinde Infotech Pvt Ltd
Court: Kozhikode Commercial Court
Filed on: 16 April 2020
Claim amount: INR 14,68,00,000/-
Issue: breach of contract. The claim must be filed as a commercial suit.
Advice given: Complete pre-institution mediation before filing the commercial suit.
Outcome: Mediation failed and the suit was filed.
Recommended next step: Seek summary judgment.
Matter code: Project Pelican
